description: This file contains utility functions for theme validation and sanitization in the Superset project, including theme structure validation, token sanitization, and font URL validation.

methods.name: _is_valid_theme_mode
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid ThemeMode.

methods.name: _is_valid_algorithm
methods.description: Validates theme algorithm which can be a string or list of strings.

methods.name: is_valid_theme
methods.description: Checks if a theme dictionary has the correct structure and types.

methods.name: sanitize_theme_tokens
methods.description: Sanitizes theme tokens, especially SVG content and URLs to prevent XSS.

methods.name: _validate_single_font_url
methods.description: Validates a single font URL, ensuring it uses HTTPS and is from an allowed domain.

methods.name: validate_font_urls
methods.description: Validates an array of font URLs, enforcing maximum count and domain restrictions.
